tips: Know your grown-up's phone number by heart.
Lost? Stay where you are and find a helper, like a worker with a name tag.
If something feels wrong, walk away and tell a grown-up you trust.
Always ask your grown-up before you go anywhere with anyone.
Keep two big steps of space from people you don't know.
badgesLine: Finish a lesson to earn its badge. Get every star to make it gold!
